# avbtool

Unmodified `avbtool.py` (AVB 1.4) from AOSP [platform/external/avb](https://android.googlesource.com/platform/external/avb) at commit `ba2dec4b035b0a3b61c5f8f8a74d86bcd450b1ee`, MIT license (`LICENSE`).

The CAF Android 10 tree ships AVB 1.1 `avbtool` for Python 2; the Picomisu release pipeline imports avbtool as a Python 3 module, and this version produces the images of the Picomisu releases byte for byte.
